scope: Admit only the exact disposable GPU1 concurrency profile and reviewed CPU orchestration. Four real M0 updates and strict reload remain runtime prerequisites inside that profile. No formal B/C training, long parallel jobs, model promotion, final accuracy or inference-latency acceptance.

checks.name: source_binding
checks.evidence: All 38 source hashes match; all parse with Python 3.7 grammar. Existing B37 matches its sealed plan unchanged. Only the disposable profiler is added.

checks.name: initialization
checks.evidence: Profiler checks review, plan, 38 sources, four input hashes, protected checkpoint, physical GPU1, run name and 180 seconds before model construction. It strictly loads fitted ad059 with stage localize/step6250/non-sanity, not current B or M0 weights.

checks.evidence: After only normalizing local variable names, sanity argument and fixed max_candidates=8, the real profiler update AST equals B history/target/preview/quality/gain-loss/optimizer core. Batch8, workers2, seed2027, AdamW lr=1e-4/weight_decay=1e-4 match B.

checks.name: data_and_label_paths
checks.evidence: EvidencePairs selects manifest train, earlier templates and GT-jittered current search. sampled_targets runs actual primary and auxiliary queries for both modalities and uses clipped original-image IoU deltas. Four consecutive M0 steps select families0,1,2,3. This is offline B sampling, not causal C training.

checks.name: gradient_freeze_and_reload
checks.evidence: Shared step_optimizer checks finite loss, calls backward, checks finite/nonzero prefix gradients for M0, clips finite gradient norm and steps AdamW. Shared B save_checkpoint requires 257 frozen state tensors, exactly8 changed quality/query-gain tensors, no frozen gradients and optimizer step4; it saves to the disposable run, strictly reloads a fresh clone and compares all12 probe fields, including K1 legacy checks. Final measured updates recheck frozen state. These conditions were inspected, not executed on a model.

checks.name: logging_cost
checks.evidence: The real profile log_update and AST-extracted formal B logging produced byte-identical step/label CSV on three synthetic batch8 fixtures (steps1,2,25), exactly16 label rows each and matching flush cadence. Formal B bookkeeping/epoch checkpoint cadence and initialization/history differ in scope; this remains a short representative B workload.

checks.name: counter_and_timing
checks.evidence: Three real counter-function fixtures cover quoted fields, >32KiB tail and a trailing partial row. Two real phase-function fixtures verify 180-second serial windows, child-terminal polling, counters and CPU busy arithmetic. Rendered controller parses as Python3.7 without importing/executing the helper.

checks.name: orchestration_and_output_scope
checks.evidence: Controller prechecks B37, deploys only profiler/plan/two review files, validates final binding and remote inputs, requires >=8192MiB free on GPU1, binds the two expected owned PIDs, and starts exactly one new run_task child on GPU1. Existing CSV/cmdline paths are read-only. New wrapper stdout/stderr and child run.log/status are preserved. No kill/restart, existing model/log write, temperature/power query or unrelated GPU query appears.

timing_and_cost.measured_window: Starts after all four M0 updates, serialization and strict clone reload plus CUDA synchronize; includes real data loading, NN updates and per-batch logging. Ends after the last full update and CUDA synchronize, so it can exceed180 seconds by the final update. Final file closure/checks lie outside this measured subwindow.
timing_and_cost.comparison_window: Use recorded full parallel interval including startup, M0, reload, measured work, exit/hash checks and observer delay. Serial before/after are each at least180 seconds with nominal15-second sampling plus hardware-call overhead.
timing_and_cost.counter_scope: Each CSV can lag by0..24 written-step labels at an endpoint. Interval deltas therefore have up to +/-24-update error; GPU0 zero-based row offset cancels. Do not claim a small speed difference unsupported by these bounds.
timing_and_cost.gpu0_scope: Report per-job GPU0 throughput/slowdown separately; its update cost differs from B and its counters must not be summed as equivalent B work.
timing_and_cost.native_terminal_overhang: parallel.completed - profile_native.completed; report the actual value. Fifteen seconds is the nominal sampling sleep, not a strict wall-clock upper bound.
timing_and_cost.memory_scope: torch.cuda peak values are lifetime peaks including M0 and simultaneous reload clone; they are not reset measured-window-only peaks. nvidia-smi values include co-resident work and utilization is a sampled GPU-busy metric, not SM occupancy.
timing_and_cost.interpretation: One before/parallel/after comparison can measure this short workload on current shared hardware. It does not establish long-run formal-job scalability, full training cost, final system latency or inference speed.
